exposure: oral sildenafil citrate administered after onset of labor
cohort: The study models outcomes for term pregnancies from onset of labor to 1 month post-birth in the context of health systems.
finding: Oral sildenafil citrate was cost-saving compared with standard care, saving £92 per birth in the UK and AU$303 per birth in Australia, while yielding the same quality adjusted life years.
mod_finding: The relative risk of emergency cesarean section and operative vaginal birth was a key input to the cost-effectiveness model, suggesting sildenafil's potential to reduce these operative modes of birth.
